messages:
Ravi (Sales): Heads-up — Lynx Health POC kickoff. They want to validate a new open-sourced medical LLM variant (lynx-13b-med) and check KV/prefix cache behavior for long patient context. Also asked for an up-front estimate for Dedicated pricing.
Maya (Solutions): Thanks. Do they need streaming responses? and what's the expected sequence length?
Ravi (Sales): Yes streaming for live charting. Typical convo + notes ~12k tokens, some retrieval state combined maybe 20k. They care about latency under 500ms tail for short turns.
Luis (Eng-ML): 20k active context is heavy. We need to confirm model supports offloading KV to disk or extended KV-cache; not all variants do. I can run a quick compatibility sniff.
Jade (Eng-Platform): For Dedicated, we can propose a config with 2x A100-80GB q4f16 quant variant or 4x H100 for better latency. Need to model throughput: how many concurrent sessions?
Ravi (Sales): Around 150 concurrent users in POC, spiky. Budget ask — they want monthly cap estimate.
Priya (Finance): For 150 conc with H100 reserved, rough ballpark is $Xk/mo (seats + infra). I'll compute a detailed quote after we nail GPU counts and token/s.
Luis (Eng-ML): Quick scan results: deploy-bot shows model size 13.4B, uses standard transformer blocks, but has custom KV serialization. Sec-bot flagged a nonstandard checkpoint signature (possible license mismatch).
sec-bot: Automated check: model_license: unclear; external_license_url: missing. Recommend legal review before provisioning.
deploy-bot: Compatibility probe: lynx-13b-med v1.2 — inference binary loaded; kv-cache methods present but not tested for >8k. Memory estimate: 52GB GPU for q4f16 + 8k KV.
Maya (Solutions): Action items: 1) Luis to run extended KV stress up to 24k, 2) Jade to draft Dedicated config and autoscale knobs for spikes, 3) Priya to produce price band, 4) legal to check license.
Luis (Eng-ML): I'll run stress tests tomorrow morning. Quick note: if model uses custom kv serialization we'll likely need a small adapter in our runtime — adds 1-2 engineer days.
Jade (Eng-Platform): On autoscale — suggest baseline pool 2 nodes with burst to 6 for POC. Need to validate cold-start times for the adapter path. If adapter required, warm images will be needed.
Priya (Finance): Can we give them a conservative estimate sheet? I'll do a low/expected/high with assumptions: concurrency, avg tokens, reserved vs burst.
Ravi (Sales): Customer asks about data residency and whether logs can be forwarded to their SIEM. Also a short SOC2 Q.
sec-bot: Security note: private deployment recommended if PHI in payloads. We can enable KMS integration and audit logs. SOC2 evidence: most already covered, but we need confirmation on retention policy.
Maya (Solutions): For the demo, we can mask PHI and use synthetic data. For production PII/PHI they should go Dedicated or Private.
Luis (Eng-ML): Test plan for me: 1) run kv stress 8k/16k/24k sequences; 2) measure per-token latency and tail percentiles; 3) try adapter flow to see overhead; 4) validate output parity with reference. I'll post results in this thread.
Ravi (Sales): Timeline: POC starts in 10 business days. Can we commit to results within 3 business days of tests?
Jade (Eng-Platform): Yes — 3 business days OK if we prioritize. I'll reserve CI slots and an instance pool window.
Priya (Finance): I'll share the draft quote by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (Solutions): Legal — looping in @legal to confirm license acceptability.
Ravi (Sales): Thanks team. If anything blocks, flag here and I'll escalate to the account. :thumbsup:
Luis (Eng-ML): Starting stress run now, will update with a short log snippet if anything fails.
deploy-bot: Stress job submitted: lynx-kv-stress-1932345678-1. Logs at: https://internal-ci/reports/lynx-kv-stress-1932345678
Maya (Solutions): Also customer question: can we restrict which model variants are visible in the catalog for their account? They want a curated whitelist.
Jade (Eng-Platform): We support per-tenant model allowlists. We need to add lynx-13b-med@v1.2 to the tenant config. Will do after legal signoff.
Ravi (Sales): Great. I'll communicate the next steps in the account call tomorrow.
Luis (Eng-ML): Update — initial 8k run passed but 16k shows memory pressure on a single A100. Adapter path increases latency ~12%. I'll push full 24k run overnight.
Priya (Finance): FYI — if adapter required, estimate add-on professional services fee (one-time) in the quote.
Maya (Solutions): Perfect. Keeping notes here.
